title: tools/factory/fleet-scorecard.py config (one project, or a list)
description: Data only (bus Law 1). A project keeps its own copy, default <root>/factory-pins/fleet-scorecard.config.json. Every section is optional; an absent section yields a null field with error NOT_CONFIGURED, never a failure. Relative paths are relative to the project root.

source.description: How a count is produced. pinned = a bus tool run through the executor's pin-runner (Law 1); argv = a project command run with cwd <root>. {root}, {bus} (the clone path), {bus:<path>} (that file as committed on the clone origin/master, materialized in a temp dir) and {python} are substituted. Parse with json (dot path) or regex (group 1) + zero_regex.

name.description: the project name on the bus (Law 6)

root.description: project root; '.' or absent = --root; relative = to this config file

config.description: a config file in that root whose matching project object overrides this entry

census_root.description: the project's root name in tools/tool-census.config.json and metrics/product-share-lines.jsonl; default name

config.description: rule-tags config in the project root; default <bus>/tools/rule-tags.config.json

delivered_regex.description: matched against commit subjects; group 1 = subject id (distinct ids are counted)
